verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's docs name a Compliance Calendar that sends email reminders about annual report deadlines, alongside alerts as those deadlines approach and real-time compliance-status notifications based on state filing office data. Together these cover the core of seeing upcoming deadlines and getting reminded before each one. missing for 10: evidence that the calendar covers filing types beyond annual reports, details of the calendar view itself (e.g., multi-entity or multi-state listing, reminder lead-time configuration), independent or hands-on corroboration
